text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64,800 while Ethereum sits flat, suggesting cautious consolidation among the two largest assets with neither gaining clear directional momentum. Altcoins like BNB and SOL are showing modest strength, but overall volume at $32B remains subdued and fear sentiment at 31 is still elevated despite a slight 7-day improvement. Bitcoin's 56.6% dominance indicates capital is neither fleeing to alts nor rushing back to the largest crypto, pointing to a market waiting for a clearer catalyst.
